fakta.en: Cats love to nap and play.
The lion is king of the jungle.

fakta.id: Setiap zebra punya belang yang berbeda.
fakta.en: Every zebra has its own stripes.

fakta.id: Orangutan tinggal di hutan Kalimantan dan Sumatra.
fakta.en: Orangutans live in the forests of Borneo and Sumatra.
Rhinos have a horn on their nose.

fakta.id: Kuda nil suka berendam di air.
fakta.en: Hippos love to soak in water.
Quokkas always look like they are smiling.
Komodo dragons live only in Indonesia.

fakta.id: Paus adalah hewan terbesar di dunia.
fakta.en: Whales are the biggest animals in the world.

fakta.id: Pinguin tidak bisa terbang, tapi jago berenang.
fakta.en: Penguins can't fly, but they swim very well.

fakta.id: Burung hantu bangun di malam hari.
Flamingo suka berdiri dengan satu kaki.
fakta.en: Flamingos like to stand on one leg.

fakta.id: Semut kuat dan suka bekerja sama.
fakta.en: Ants are strong and work together.

fakta.id: Lingkaran itu bulat dan tidak punya sudut.
fakta.en: A circle is round and has no corners.

fakta.id: Persegi punya 4 sisi yang sama panjang.
fakta.en: A square has 4 sides that are all the same.
A triangle has 3 sides and 3 corners.

fakta.id: Persegi panjang punya 2 sisi panjang dan 2 sisi pendek.
fakta.en: A rectangle has 2 long sides and 2 short sides.

fakta.id: Oval itu bulat lonjong, seperti telur.
fakta.en: An oval is a stretched circle, like an egg.

fakta.id: Belah ketupat punya 4 sisi yang miring.
Segi lima punya 5 sisi dan 5 sudut.
fakta.en: A pentagon has 5 sides and 5 corners.

fakta.id: Segi enam punya 6 sisi, seperti sarang lebah.
fakta.en: A hexagon has 6 sides, like a honeycomb.

teks.en: The fish is in the water.
The monkey likes to eat bananas.
The duck swims in the pond.
The elephant has a long trunk.
My little brother eats ice cream.
The rabbit likes to eat carrots.
The airplane flies in the sky.
